images.content: ## Food should be **stored off the ground on shelves** to help keep premises clean, discourage pests and avoid water damage or contamination in areas where floors are wet cleaned.
## **Raw food** should be **stored separately from or below ready-to-eat foods** to avoid contamination to transfer.
## Store the food in **containers or other food-grade wrappings** (i.e., safe for food use).
## **Inspect packaged food** regularly to ensure it remains intact and protects food properly. Dispose of any food that might get contaminated because the packaging is unsuitable or damaged.
## Apply the **FIFO **method (First IN, First OUT) to protect the product quality and freshness.

images.caption: ## **Don't crowd** the storage area (including the cool room or freezer).
## If you are concerned about pests, contact **pest control service** immediately.
## Store whole **eggs** in **cool rooms or refrigerators** wherever possible and make sure they are kept dry and clean.
## Have **refrigerators and cool rooms regularly checked** and serviced by a qualified technician.
## During a power failure, keep **all cool room and refrigerator doors closed**. Check the temperatures of all food.
